messages:
Priya Nair: FYI i'm going to consolidate the Hello Serverless quickstart into one page and add small language tabs for node/python/go. main goals: update SDK v5 auth, remove deprecated token-file deep example, add ephemeral minting server snippet, and fix the lingering link to the old CLI guide. opening PR in ~1h. looking for eng-platform and devex eyes.

Jonah Reed: thanks. i can review the Go example and runtime call shapes. please keep the non-streaming simple example first, then streaming as optional.

Carlos Mendez: Devex here. can we standardize the env var names? suggest SERVER_RW_KEY and CLIENT_RW_EPHEM. also add a tiny diagram showing where ephemeral keys live (server -> client). i'll draft the diagram text.

Priya Nair: sounds good. i'll switch to SERVER_RW_KEY and CLIENT_RW_EPHEM. adding a short caption for the diagram.

Nina Park: quick note: the link in the current quickstart points to docs.redwood.dev/old-cli which 404s — please update to the new cli install page. also add a note about region flags for hosted customers.

Priya Nair: thanks, will fix link and add a one-line region example: `--region=eu-west-1`.

Jonah Reed: Go snippet: i suggest using the typed client and show `client.Generate(ctx, &GenerateOptions{ Model: \"gpt-l\", Input: \"hello\" })` — emphasize `Model` field name. i'll paste a minimal version when PR lands.

Priya Nair: good catch on Model naming. i'll unify field casing across samples.

Carlos Mendez: UX tweak: replace the big JSON blob example with a concise 3-field payload and link to the full sample file. keeps the page scannable.

Priya Nair: done. will move the long example to `examples/hello-serverless/payload.json`.

preview-bot: Preview build queued for PR #1501  build 8920. Preview URL: https://deploy-preview-1501.redwood.dev (available in ~3m).

Priya Nair: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1501  reviewers requested: @Jonah Reed @Carlos Mendez. please ack.

Jonah Reed: ack, i'll review and add the Go snippet.

Carlos Mendez: starting doc review. leaving comments about headings and adding a small callout about backwards compatibility for token-file users.

Nina Park: small grammar nit in the python section: \"youll\" -> \"you'll\". also suggest showing `pip install redwood-sdk` in a code block.

Priya Nair: fixing typos and adding pip example.

Jonah Reed: pushed a tiny commit with the Go sample and a note about `client.Stream()` for streaming examples.

Carlos Mendez: LGTM after a couple tiny wording nits. advising to keep legacy token example in a collapsible with deprecation note.

Priya Nair: added collapsible legacy snippet and a short migration note: \"If you still use API tokens on the server, move to SERVER_RW_KEY and rotate every 30d.\"

preview-bot: Preview ready: https://deploy-preview-1501.redwood.dev

Carlos Mendez: reviewed preview. the diagram looks good. can we add alt text for accessibility? i'll add an alt text suggestion inline.

Priya Nair: added alt text. also added a short troubleshooting section: common 401 causes (wrong key env, expired ephemeral) + 403 (insufficient scope).

Jonah Reed: approved. left one nit to make the Go import path consistent with our pkg naming.

Carlos Mendez: approved.

Priya Nair: merged and published. thanks all! i'll follow up with a short announcement in #docs once the staged redirect is live. :rocket:
